_meta.notes: Comprehensive index for China covering Neolithic cultures (Yangshao, Longshan), Xia-Shang-Zhou dynasties, Warring States, Qin unification, Han dynasty and Silk Road, Three Kingdoms, Tang golden age, Song innovations, Yuan (Mongol), Ming (Great Wall/Forbidden City/Zheng He), Qing dynasty, Opium Wars, Taiping Rebellion, Republic (Sun Yat-sen), warlords, Japanese invasion, Chinese Civil War, PRC (Mao/Great Leap Forward/Cultural Revolution), Deng Xiaoping reforms, Tiananmen 1989, economic miracle, Xi Jinping era, and Belt and Road Initiative.

religion.note: Officially atheist state; folk religion includes ancestor worship, Confucian values, Taoist/Buddhist syncretism; underground Catholic and Protestant churches; Muslim Hui and Uyghur minorities

ethnic_groups.name: Han Chinese
ethnic_groups.notes: World's largest ethnic group; diverse sub-groups by dialect/region: Mandarin, Wu (Shanghainese), Cantonese (Yue), Min (Hokkien/Teochew), Hakka, Gan, Xiang; unified by Chinese characters

ethnic_groups.name: Zhuang
ethnic_groups.notes: Largest minority; Tai-speaking; Guangxi; closely related to Thai/Lao; rice terraces; historically Nanyue cultural sphere

ethnic_groups.name: Uyghur
ethnic_groups.notes: Turkic Muslim; Xinjiang; Uyghur language; East Turkestan independence movement; mass internment camps ('re-education') since 2017; UN: possible crimes against humanity

ethnic_groups.name: Hui
ethnic_groups.notes: Chinese-speaking Muslims; dispersed nationwide; Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region; descended from Arab/Persian traders and Chinese converts; Dungan

ethnic_groups.name: Manchu
ethnic_groups.notes: Tungusic; Manchuria/northeast; founded Qing dynasty (1644-1912); largely assimilated; Manchu language nearly extinct

ethnic_groups.name: Miao (Hmong)
ethnic_groups.notes: Guizhou, Yunnan, Hunan; Hmong-Mien; highland farming; silver jewellery; many fled to Southeast Asia/US after Vietnam War

ethnic_groups.name: Yi (Lolo)
ethnic_groups.notes: Tibeto-Burman; Sichuan, Yunnan; Nuosu script; traditionally caste-based society

ethnic_groups.name: Tujia
ethnic_groups.notes: Hunan, Hubei; Tibeto-Burman; mountain areas; largely assimilated into Han

ethnic_groups.name: Tibetan
ethnic_groups.notes: Tibeto-Burman; Tibet, Qinghai, Sichuan, Gansu, Yunnan; Vajrayana Buddhist; Dalai Lama in exile since 1959; contested autonomy

ethnic_groups.name: Mongol
ethnic_groups.notes: Inner Mongolia; Mongolic; pastoralists; Yuan dynasty heritage; cross-border with Mongolia

ethnic_groups.name: Korean
ethnic_groups.notes: Yanbian Autonomous Prefecture, Jilin; Korean-speaking; cross-border with North Korea

ethnic_groups.name: Other (55 recognised nationalities total)
ethnic_groups.notes: Dong, Yao, Bai, Hani, Kazakh, Dai (Thai), Li, Lisu, Wa, She, Lahu, Shui, Naxi, Qiang, Tu, Mulao, Xibe, Kirgiz, Daur, Jingpo, Salar, Blang, Tajik, Achang, Pumi, Ewenki, Nu, Jino, De'ang, Bonan, Russian, Yugur, Uzbek, Monba, Oroqen, Derung, Tatar, Hezhen, Lhoba, Gaoshan

country_profile.time_zone: CST (UTC+8, single time zone for entire country)

independence.notes: Republic of China 1912; PRC proclaimed 1949; ROC government retreated to Taiwan

country_profile.notes_unique: World's most populous country (until 2023, surpassed by India); 5,000+ year continuous civilisation; permanent UNSC member; world's largest GDP by PPP; 56 recognised ethnic groups

geography.terrain: Diverse — Tibetan Plateau (west), deserts (northwest), plains (east), mountains (south/west/north)
geography.notes: World's 3rd/4th largest country; 14 land neighbours (most of any country); Great Wall stretches 21,000+ km; Three Gorges Dam world's largest power station; South China Sea territorial claims.

economy_extended.notes: World's 2nd largest economy; 'world's factory'; BRI (Belt and Road) initiative; real estate crisis (Evergrande/Country Garden); tech sector global leader; common prosperity drive; dual circulation strategy; aging population challenge.

health.notes: 95%+ health insurance coverage; Traditional Chinese Medicine (TCM) integrated; COVID origin controversy (Wuhan 2019); massive hospital/public health infrastructure; air pollution health impacts; aging society challenges.

food_agriculture.notes: World's largest agricultural producer; pork consumption #1 globally; soybean import dependency (largest buyer); African swine fever 2018-19 decimated pig herd; food security strategic priority; arable land loss to urbanization.

energy.notes: World's largest energy consumer; #1 renewable energy capacity (solar, wind, hydro); #1 CO2 emitter; Three Gorges Dam world's largest hydropower; coal still 55%+ of energy; 2060 carbon neutrality target; EV market leader (60%+ of global EV sales).

transport.notes: World's longest high-speed rail network (42,000+ km); 7 of world's 10 busiest container ports; Belt and Road infrastructure expanding globally; highway network world's largest; maglev in Shanghai; world's longest bridge (Danyang-Kunshan).

tourism.notes: 57 UNESCO World Heritage Sites (2nd most globally after Italy); world's 4th most visited country; domestic tourism massive (6 billion+ trips/year); Golden Week holidays; visa policies eased 2023-24.

legal_system.suffrage: 18 years, universal (elections at local level only; CCP controls)
legal_system.notes: One-party state (CCP); world's highest number of executions (estimated thousands/year, state secret); National Security Law; Social Credit System; rule by law rather than rule of law.

human_rights_gender.notes: Uyghur detention camps (Xinjiang); Tibet restrictions; Hong Kong crackdown (NSL); Great Firewall censorship; social credit system; Mao-era gender equality progress but persistent gaps; one-child policy legacy (1979-2015).

security_stability.notes: Military modernization (world's 3rd largest defence budget ~$290B); Taiwan Strait tensions; South China Sea disputes; India border standoff (Ladakh); nuclear weapons state (350+ warheads); surveillance state capabilities.

cultural_heritage.notes: 5,000+ year continuous civilization; Four Great Inventions (paper, printing, gunpowder, compass); Confucianism, Taoism, Buddhism shaped East Asian civilization; Mandarin most spoken language globally.

comparative_rankings.notes: World's 2nd largest economy and leading manufacturer; tech giant (Huawei, Alibaba, Tencent, BYD); poor freedom and environmental scores; space programme; AI leader.
comparative_rankings._note: Country position relative to continent and global. 'rank' = 1 is best/largest.

current_leader.name: Xi Jinping
current_leader.title: General Secretary of CCP / President / CMC Chairman
current_leader.notes: CCP; 'core leader'; removed term limits 2018; most powerful since Mao; anti-corruption; Belt and Road; common prosperity; Taiwan tensions; 'Xi Jinping Thought'

former_leaders.name: Mao Zedong
former_leaders.notes: Founder of PRC; CCP Chairman; Long March; Great Leap Forward (famine: 15-55 million dead); Cultural Revolution; died September 1976

former_leaders.name: Deng Xiaoping
former_leaders.notes: 'Reform and Opening Up'; Special Economic Zones; Tiananmen Square crackdown 1989; 'Socialism with Chinese Characteristics'; 'It doesn't matter whether the cat is black or white'

former_leaders.name: Jiang Zemin

former_leaders.name: Hu Jintao
former_leaders.notes: CCP; 'Harmonious Society'; economic boom; 2008 Olympics; collective leadership; removed from 2022 Party Congress podium

former_leaders.name: Sun Yat-sen
former_leaders.notes: 'Father of the Nation' (ROC); Xinhai Revolution; Three Principles of the People; KMT founder

former_leaders.name: Chiang Kai-shek
former_leaders.notes: KMT; Nationalist government; Northern Expedition; WWII leader; lost civil war; retreated to Taiwan
